Optional: 'image' (a picture you put in public/work/, e.g. "/work/poster.jpg"), 'video' (a YouTube or Vimeo link; YouTube also gives the card its picture), 'link' (any web page), 'role', 'collaborators', 'details'. category must be one of: Design, Video, Storytelling, Collaborations, Technology.
name: Herbert Gracia
tagline: Mission-driven nonprofit leader with 21 years at the Fromm Institute, driving strategy, fundraising, marketing, and community partnerships for older adults in San Francisco.

stats.label: older adult learners served each year
businesses founded and scaled to exit

about: Recognized for building strong relationships with Boards, staff, donors, and community partners while leading with vision, creativity, and empathy.
An advocate for older adults as lifelong contributors, leading initiatives that advance social justice and counter ageism in programming, communications, and community outreach.
community: Built strong, transparent relationships with a 21-member Board of Directors, enhancing governance and fiscal accountability across all programs.
Developed a close partnership with the University of San Francisco Technology Department to jointly improve Fromm's technology infrastructure.
United staff and more than 20 volunteers around shared goals, improving program delivery and participant satisfaction.
Leveraged partnerships with five+ retirement homes, donor networks, and city agencies to expand enrollment across San Francisco.

experience.company: Fromm Institute for Lifelong Learning, University of San Francisco
experience.summary: Key member of the Institute's senior leadership and executive planning groups. Partner with the Board of Directors and senior leaders on governance, fiscal oversight, succession planning, and long-term strategy for a nonprofit serving 1,500+ older adult learners each year.
highlights: Marketing & Communications: Direct all marketing and PR across digital and print. Grew communications from zero presence to a multi-channel program reaching 1,500+ older learners and increasing enrollment by 10%. Currently leading all marketing and PR for Fromm's 50th Anniversary.

Fundraising & Donor Engagement: Member of the leadership group responsible for fundraising strategy. Designed donor appreciation events and stewardship campaigns, and created the metrics and messaging that show why lifelong learning matters to older adults' health and social connection.

Technology & Finance: Led the launch of a new website, member apps, and classroom equipment upgrades. Directed a Salesforce-based website redesign with integrated payment and donor systems (Stripe, CashNet), bringing tuition, donations, and enrollment management in-house.

Program Innovation: Led the move to hybrid learning for in-person and online members. Designed and launched Frommcast, an online subscription platform for recorded classes, and now oversee the move of all content to the Institute's new YouTube programs.
Board & Staff Relationships: Built lasting trust with Board members, faculty, staff, and volunteers over 21 years, fostering collaboration, transparency, and shared mission.
Community Connector: Established partnerships with retirement homes and senior-serving organizations throughout San Francisco, positioning elderhood as a time of contribution, not decline.
Equity & Advocacy: Led efforts to make Fromm's programs welcoming and accessible to all older adults, countering ageism and expanding diversity and inclusion.
Public Voice: Represent the Institute at donor events, faculty presentations, and community gatherings as a storyteller, advocate, and spokesperson.

experience.summary: Founded and scaled two businesses to successful exits, demonstrating strong financial stewardship, fundraising acumen, and creative brand leadership.
highlights: Led operations across finance, production, hiring, and design while building strong teams and community partnerships.
